provenance.note: A point ON or beside the body of water this question is about, as a Point: the pick's {coordinates, name} verbatim, a (lon, lat) pair, 'lat,lon' or a point layer (geocode a place name first). The mapped outline that point names becomes the domain; a domain supplied directly supersedes it, and a body nobody mapped is drawn [supplied on this invocation]
Epilimnion (warm surface layer) temperature the column OPENS at. The run exchanges no heat with the atmosphere, so what happens to this difference is the whole answer [supplied on this invocation]
Hypolimnion (cold bottom layer) temperature; the initial top-to-bottom difference is what the run either keeps or mixes away [supplied on this invocation]

Depth of the thermocline below the free surface. The vertical grid is planned to HOLD it and REFUSES when no admissible sigma stretch over the domain's deepest column can [supplied on this invocation]

Target triangle edge the water body's interior is meshed at. The horizontal spends its budget on COVERING the body rather than on detail; the 3D node count is this mesh's nodes times the planes the deck states [supplied on this invocation]
Solve sizing class - how many cores the solve is partitioned across. An engine that runs on one core says so on the card [declared constant default]

Vertical datum this run counts every elevation from - the bed under it and the level over it. A source published on another frame reaches this one through a measured offset, and a pair nobody publishes an offset between refuses by name [declared constant default]
